Membership and Systems Manager

Permanent part-time | 15 hours per week | Hybrid | Edgecliff, Sydney

PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy is recruiting a Membership and Systems Manager for a respected, long-established medical membership organisation based in Edgecliff.

This is a permanent part-time opportunity offering approximately 15 hours per week. The role will combine membership administration, member engagement, database and CRM management, reporting, operational coordination and support for the organisation’s systems transition.

About the role

The Membership and Systems Manager will support the effective delivery of membership services while maintaining accurate systems, records and reporting.

Key responsibilities include:

Managing membership enquiries and providing responsive member support
Maintaining accurate membership records and database information
Supporting membership applications, renewals and related administration
Producing membership reports and monitoring data quality
Coordinating member communications and engagement activities
Supporting the implementation and ongoing use of the organisation’s membership management system
Assisting with data migration, validation, reconciliation and process documentation
Liaising with internal stakeholders and external software or service providers
Identifying opportunities to improve membership and administrative processes
Providing general operational and administrative support as required
About you

You may currently work in a professional association, membership organisation, not-for-profit, medical college, education provider or another member-focused environment.

You will ideally bring:

Experience in membership services, association administration or customer service
Experience using a membership database, CRM or Association Management System
Strong data accuracy, reporting and record-management skills
Confidence communicating with members and senior stakeholders
Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently
Experience supporting a system implementation or data migration would be highly regarded
Experience with Microsoft Upbeat CRM would be particularly advantageous

This opportunity may suit an experienced professional seeking meaningful part-time work, balancing other professional or personal commitments, building a portfolio career or returning to the workforce.

Working arrangement
Permanent part-time employment
Approximately 15 hours per week
Usually worked across two days
Hybrid working arrangement
At least one day per week in the Edgecliff office is preferred
Salary

The salary range is:

$90,000–$105,000 per annum plus superannuation on a full-time equivalent basis.

As this role is approximately 0.4 FTE, the actual pro-rated salary is approximately:

$36,000–$42,000 per annum plus superannuation.

This equates to approximately $46–$54 per hour, depending on the final salary offered.

Eligibility

Applicants must have valid Australian working rights. Candidates holding temporary visas may be considered, subject to verification of their individual visa conditions and ongoing ability to perform the required hours.
How to apply

Please apply through Workforce Australia and include an up-to-date CV outlining your relevant membership, CRM, database, reporting and stakeholder-engagement experience.

For a confidential discussion, contact:

Pri Menon Gillett
Founder and Managing Director
PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy Pty Ltd
Email: pri@primarecruitmentandconsultancy.com.au
PRIMA welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including professionals returning to the workforce.

About Us

RISU Care Pty Ltd is a reputable, Australian-owned company dedicated to delivering high-quality, person-centered care that allows our aged and disabled clients to live safely and with dignity in the comfort of their own homes. We are known for our commitment to compassionate service and employee support.

The Role and Key Responsibilities
We are recruiting for dedicated, professional individuals to join our team as Full-Time Aged or Disabled Carers. The primary focus of this rewarding role is to provide essential care, practical assistance, and companionship to our clients.
Your duties, which are exactly as per the job description, will include:
• Providing dedicated emotional support, companionship, and friendship.
• Accompanying aged and disabled persons during daily activities
• Assisting clients with their mobility
• Preparing food for clients
• Arranging social activities
• Performing housekeeping tasks such as vacuuming and cleaning
• Assisting in personal hygiene and dressing
• Providing companionship, friendship and emotional support
• May do shopping and run errands
• Provides general household assistance, emotional support, care and companionship for aged or disabled people

Mandatory Skills, Qualifications, and Experience
To be considered for this position, candidates must demonstrate the following criteria:
• Qualifications: A minimum of an AQF Certificate III in Individual Support (Aged Care/Disability) or a higher, relevant vocational qualification is required.
• Experience: A minimum of one year (12 months) of full-time (or equivalent part-time) paid experience providing direct client care (Aged or Disabled Carer) is essential.
• Skills: Demonstrated proficiency in all personal care tasks and adherence to safe work practices, including manual handling.
• Certifications: Current certifications in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitations (CPR) must be held.
• General: A valid Australian Driver's License, access to a reliable vehicle, and a current Australian National Police Check are mandatory.

Salary & Benefits (Nominated Salary Range)
We offer a highly competitive remuneration package that reflects the expertise and commitment required for this role.
Nominated Annual Salary Range AUD $77,000 – $85,000 per annum

Additional Benefits Statutory Superannuation (currently 12%) and generous penalty rates for weekend and public holiday shifts.

To apply, candidates must submit their CV and a cover letter (in English Language) that clearly addresses the above essential criteria through this portal.

NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd
Walkaway, Western Australia

Full Time Mobile Plant Operator 
(2 Positions Available)

Salary
AUD $90,000 – $100,000 per annum plus Superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

About us:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd is a family-owned agricultural enterprise based in Walkaway, Western Australia, approximately 30 minutes from Geraldton. We operate approximately 4.2 hectares of plastic greenhouses in Walkaway and an additional 2 hectares of plastic greenhouses at the family’s original farm.
We are currently expanding our operations, having purchased 60 acres of land near Walkaway to support future growth and long-term sustainability. NVD Fresh Produce specialises in intensive greenhouse cultivation and is progressively diversifying its crop range, recognising crop rotation as a key strategy to preserve soil health, improve productivity, and maintain consistent supply.

The business is focused on strengthening its production capacity, improving operational systems and water management practices, and establishing a scalable and sustainable structure to support ongoing expansion within Western Australia’s fresh produce market.

The successful applicant will play an important role in supporting the continued growth and success of NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations.

Position Summary
The Mobile Plant Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of mobile plant and agricultural machinery to support NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations. The role involves operating and maintaining plant and equipment for land preparation, cultivation, material handling and general farm activities while ensuring workplace safety, operational efficiency and equipment reliability.

Key Responsibilities
Mobile Plant Operations
•	Operate mobile plant and agricultural machinery safely and efficiently in support of farming operations. 
•	Operate machinery for land preparation, cultivation, material handling and general farm activities. 
•	Load, transport and position goods, materials and equipment as required. 
•	Operate machinery in accordance with workplace procedures and manufacturer guidelines. 

Equipment Maintenance
•	Conduct routine pre-start and post-operation inspections of machinery and equipment. 
•	Report mechanical faults, maintenance requirements and safety issues promptly. 
•	Perform routine cleaning and basic daily maintenance of plant and equipment. 
•	Maintain accurate operational and maintenance records where required. 

Farm Operations Support
•	Assist with general farm operations during planting, harvesting and production periods. 
•	Support the movement of equipment, machinery and materials across farm sites. 
•	Work collaboratively with farm managers and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations. 

Workplace Safety
•	Follow workplace health and safety procedures at all times. 
•	Ensure the safe operation of mobile plant and equipment. 
•	Maintain a professional and safety-focused approach while undertaking all duties.

Qualifications and Skills
Applicants should possess one of the following:
•	A relevant AQF Certificate II qualification (or equivalent) together with at least 1 year's relevant post-qualification employment experience (20+ hours per week); or 
•	At least 2 years' relevant employment experience (10+ hours per week) in lieu of a formal qualification, together with an additional 2 years' relevant full-time employment experience. 

In addition, applicants should demonstrate:
•	Experience operating mobile plant and agricultural machinery in a farming, agricultural or horticultural environment. 
•	Ability to operate mobile plant and agricultural machinery safely and efficiently in accordance with workplace procedures. 
•	Ability to perform routine equipment inspections and basic daily maintenance. 
•	Ability to identify and report mechanical faults and maintenance requirements. 
•	Ability to follow work instructions and communicate effectively with supervisors and team members. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. 
•	A current Australian driver's licence is required. 
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety.


How to apply:

Applications open on 10 July 2026 and close on 9 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

You will contribute to research and teaching in digital electronics, FPGA design and embedded systems, while delivering high-quality teaching across undergraduate and postgraduate Electrical Engineering programs. You will also undertake research and scholarly activities that strengthen the School’s capabilities and contribute to high-impact outcomes across digital electronics systems and related areas of electrical engineering.
